summary: Choose automatic fleet transport preference with st fleet transports add fabric --prefer

replay.detail: No claim replay or stored-history changes.

schema.detail: Uses the existing ordered fleet.toml transports list; no database schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordinated member upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: The local fleet.toml transports list filters enabled automatic Tailscale/Fabric routes and determines their order for replication and peer relay. Loopback remains last. Legacy operation without fleet.toml remains Tailscale-first. Explicit config peer URLs and --peer overrides retain highest priority. Adding Fabric without --prefer preserves existing order; --prefer moves new or already enabled Fabric to the front without reconfiguring an existing exposure. Removal preserves remaining order.

downtime.detail: Transport commands refresh installed services. Without services or with --no-service, restart st3 replication-worker as instructed to apply local settings.

manual.detail: No action is required to retain existing ordered settings. To prefer Fabric on a member, run st fleet transports add fabric --prefer; Fabric trust and service grants remain required. Remove explicit peer overrides if automatic preference should choose the carrier.

recovery.detail: No stored-state recovery changes. Transport removal continues to require another usable transport.
